recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition album cover featuring a group of performers in vibrant orange-red outfits against a deep blue background, topped by massive, 3D airbrushed chrome typography with a secondary script element.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary color contrast between orange-red attire and deep blue background
Horizontal division between the upper typographic zone and lower photographic zone
Dynamic 3D chrome lettering acting as a heavy visual header
Group posing in a triangular formation to create a central focal point
coreInvariants: High-shine metallic chrome texture on display text
Soft-focus studio lighting with slight motion blur in background elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of seven people occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame in a tiered, symmetrical arrangement.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, metallic 3D title text spanning the top half of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright chrome title, follows the diagonal underline down to the subtitle, and then rests on the central figure of the group below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid blue field behind the typography provides breathing room for the complex metallic effects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subjects and text against a dark, medium-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, wide sans-serif with extreme 3D extrusion
letterConstructionRules: Letters feature a sharp, beveled edge
Extrusion follows a consistent downward-right perspective
Surface rendering mimics airbrushed chrome with high-contrast gradients and white highlights
A long, tapered underline bar extends from the base of the letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' characters are oversized and bookend the main word
The 'Y' and 'V' share similar angular troughs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy metallic industrial display paired with a fluid, organic script for contrast.
graphicDevices: Soft blue light streaks in the background

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the wide, geometric base for the chrome lettering.
Approximates the casual, slanted feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of seven people with 1970s hairstyles wearing matching vibrant orange-red suits and dresses, posed in a studio setting. The background is a solid deep cobalt blue with faint vertical light streaks. The composition is split, leaving the top 40% of the frame as a solid blue field.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, 3D chrome-textured title in the top blue section with a heavy beveled look and a long metallic underline. Below the underline on the right, add a slanted script subtitle in solid orange-red.

verificationChecks: Is the chrome texture airbrushed with high-contrast highlights?
Are the outfits a consistent vibrant orange-red?
Is the background a deep, saturated blue?
Does the typography have a significant 3D depth?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Specific shade of the blue background
mustRedesign: Brand logos in the top left corner

avoid: Modern digital gradients that lack the airbrushed feel

postGenerationChecks: Check that the chrome text looks like a physical object with depth.
Ensure the orange of the text matches the orange of the clothing.
Verify the background blue is uniform and deep.
Confirm the group is centered and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [70s Soul Group Photography] with [Airbrushed Chrome 3D Typography] over a [Deep Blue Solid Background] using a [Complementary Orange-Blue Palette].
